{
  "candidate_rtl": "module crc32_d8(
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);

function [39:0] crc_mask;
    input integer out_idx;
    reg [39:0] state_vec [0:31];
    reg [39:0] data_vec [0:7];
    reg [39:0] shifted_out [0:7];
    reg [39:0] feedback;
    integer i;
    integer j;
    integer k;
    begin
        for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
            state_vec[i] = 40'b0;
            state_vec[i][i] = 1'b1;
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            data_vec[i] = 40'b0;
            data_vec[i][32+i] = 1'b1;
            shifted_out[i] = 40'b0;
        end

        for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin
            feedback = state_vec[0] ^ data_vec[k];
            shifted_out[k] = state_vec[0];

            for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                state_vec[j] = state_vec[j+1];
            state_vec[31] = 40'b0;

            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1) begin
                if ((32'hedb88320 >> j) & 1)
                    state_vec[j] = state_vec[j] ^ feedback;
            end
        end

        if (out_idx < 32)
            crc_mask = state_vec[out_idx];
        else
            crc_mask = shifted_out[7-(out_idx-32)];
    end
endfunction

genvar n;
generate
    for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
        assign state_out[n] = ^({data_in, state_in} & crc_mask(n));
    end
    for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
        assign data_out[n] = ^({data_in, state_in} & crc_mask(32+n));
    end
endgenerate

endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original generic parametrizable implementation carries mask-generation machinery and independently constructs wide XOR cones through a generic LFSR function. The fixed reflected CRC32 byte transform is a 40-by-40 GF(2) linear map; the candidate specializes that map at elaboration while retaining one constant-mask XOR cone per observed output bit.",
  "rewrite": "Specialized the exact fixed instance to the reflected CRC32 polynomial 0xEDB88320, generated the state and shifted-data output masks as compile-time constants, and removed parameters, branches, generic configuration handling, and runtime LFSR iteration. data_out remains fully observed and is mapped to the reverse order of the eight serially shifted-out bits required by REVERSE=1.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Likely modest improvement in mapped maximum data arrival, primarily from eliminating generic configuration logic and exposing constant 40-input GF(2) cones directly to cleanup and balancing. The exact gain is tool- and mapping-dependent; functional equivalence and electrical limits remain the acceptance criteria.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Expected area is at or below the 2752.64 um^2 cap because the implementation contains only 40 fixed XOR reductions and no sequential, storage, or generic helper logic. Compile-time constant-function evaluation may increase frontend elaboration work but does not add hardware.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All 40 input bits are unconstrained and all 40 outputs are driven. The design preserves arbitrary state_in behavior, reflected Galois CRC32 byte advancement, polynomial 0x04C11DB7 equivalently represented as 0xEDB88320 in reflected form, feed-forward disabled, and the exact data_out behavior of the supplied wrapper. No initialization, reset, framing, inversion, valid gating, assumptions, or parameter settings are introduced."
}
